sentences.text: Coburgosuchus is an extinct genus of reptile belonging to the group Phytosauria, a family of crocodile-like predators.
The genus was named after Coburg, Germany, the location where the type specimens were discovered.
This animal lived during the Late Triassic period, specifically between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago in the Norian stage.
Scientists debate whether Coburgosuchus is actually synonymous with other phytosaurs like Nicrosaurus or Phytosaurus.
